parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: Hey! Heeeeeeey! Wake up, sleepyhead! Gosh, are you just gonna stare into space the WHOLE day?

parts.text: The woman standing before you holds a smile through her playful concern. Her dress and ribbons flow along with the cool breeze.
Each syllable in her words radiates a charm like the notes of a melody. She takes a step closer and gently flicks you on the forehead in an attempt to snap you out of your daze.

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: Oh! Well that did it. Welcome back to ground level you little astronaut~ I was starting to get worried about you.

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: What’s your name? I don’t think I’ve seen you around this part of Atastria before.

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: Hexatunes, huh? Such an interesting name! I’ll be sure to commit it to memory.

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: I’m Lullaby, nice to meet you! I’m a second year music major at the University of Cerulea.

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: Are… you studying there too? You look like you’re kinda close to the same age as me.

parts.text: I’m completely new here, I really don’t know what’s going on.

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: Oh! So are you like, a first year?

parts.text: No, I mean I have no clue what this place is.
Lullaby seems to freeze for a moment, stunned, as if you just told her you eat cereal with water.
